notes.title: Matchpoop Is Out Now

We're excited to announce that Matchpoop is now available for download on Steam! 
[list]
[*] Dive into a world of toilet-bound challenges as you conquer mischievous poops and save the bathroom from this hilarious invasion.

Are you ready to rise to the challenge and become the ultimate poop-slaying champion? Download Matchpoop now and flush away those invaders!

notes.title: Upcoming Matchpoop Release Celebration
notes.content:
Prepare for a poop-slaying adventure like no other! We're thrilled to announce the launch of "Matchpoop" on November 30.

[h3]🪣 About Matchpoop:[/h3]
In Matchpoop, you'll step into the shoes of a brave hero tasked with saving the bathroom from mischievous and invading poops! Use your matching skills to conquer challenging levels, defeat mighty poop overlords, and reclaim the territory.

[h3]🧻 Key Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Match-N mechanics for addictive gameplay.
[*]Battle against a variety of unique poop adversaries.
[*]Explore 250 handcrafted levels with story elements.
[*]Solve the mystery of the poop invasion and restore bathroom peace!
[/list]
Mark your calendars for November 30 and get ready to embark on a hilarious, challenging, and poop-tastic journey. Are you up for the challenge? Stay tuned for more details and get ready to match your way to victory!
